title.narrative: Agricultural Business Initiative - Development

description.narrative: Agricultural Business Initiative (aBi) Development’s overall objective is to enhance green and inclusive growth in Uganda’s agri-food systems. To achieve this aBi Development builds capacity of farmers and agribusinesses to promote climate smart agriculture practices and green technologies. aBi Development mobilises green investment from the private sector and development partners and facilitates market system development and linkages. Ultimately, farmers (including refugees) and agribusinesses will become more resilient to climate change and increase their production, productivity, and incomes.

tag.narrative: By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
